Disclaimer: Game bought before it became 'Anniversary Edition' and the price increased. Perhaps the best you could ask for when it comes to a 40K game. Loud, bombastic, and enough shouting of 'For the Emperor' to make the toughest inquisitor blush. It is rather short and unfortunately I did find it to become quite repetitive with little combat and enemy variation but there's enough fun to be had here for Third Person shooter/Hack and Slash gamers and fans of 40K alike. I will mention, this game is possibly best enjoyed if you have some knowledge of how the 40K universe works, cos this game explains nothing. Huge recommendation when it was the original version, not played it as the 'Updated' version. Due to the short length and repetitive nature of the game, waiting til sale may be advisable but if you're a massive 40K fan who somehow hasn't played it yet, go right ahead.

perfect game with great enemy units that are well placed in ever encounter such as ranged units in the back or taking high ground and close quarters units rushing you making the game feel more immersive.  every weapon in this game is very fun to use and there are plenty of weapons to choose from that you unlock throughout the campaign.  kind of short campaign playing on normal difficulty i beat the game in 6 hours but every minute of game play is well paced and an absolute blast. game runs smooth and controls are  nice and tight.
